summary: mparpəṭo is a Part. Pass. predicate agreeing with the blanket. The passage describes a resulting material condition, without asserting who tore it or a new tearing event.
The existing attributive kaġad mparpṭo and the new blanket predicate support one Detransitive state sense. They do not establish any finite Detransitive forms.
No evidence here bears on the active reflexive bird-struggling or figurative boasting uses; their inherited wording and single active sense number remain unchanged.
Can speakers provide finite Detransitive forms for tearing, distinct from the Part. Pass. state? The present entry addition makes no claim about them.
Cloth blanket rather than paper as affected material; same torn-state meaning, not a new material-specific sense.
